crossRefs.note: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to…
Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath, but the whole land will…
Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh…
“God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.
In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.
There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
Then Yahweh’s angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians. When men…

translations.web: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?
translations.bsb: Can your wealth or all your mighty effort keep you from distress?
translations.kjv: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.
translations.asv: Will thy cry avail, that thou be not in distress, Or all the forces of thy strength?
